ks-sedgwick-county-2026-2.legal_basis: Resolution No. 049-2026, interim development control suspending BESS Conditional Use applications
ks-sedgwick-county-2026-2.trigger: Zoning code allows BESS as a Renewable Energy System subject to Conditional Use review, but no BESS-specific regulations/standards exist.
ks-sedgwick-county-2026-2.current_status: Resolution No. 049-2026 was adopted 2026-03-11 and published 2026-03-19. It suspends specified BESS applications in unincorporated Sedgwick County, including primary uses and ancillary systems of at least 600 kWh. The published resolution states it remains in effect until the earlier of March 12, 2027, or adoption and publication of BESS zoning provisions; it also permits earlier amendment or termination. Current force as of 2026-11-05 was not established. [VERIFY: precise boundary interpretation of until March 12 versus county summary through March 11, adopted text correspondence and later actions.]

mi-oshtemo-charter-township-2026-2.duration: Six months unless amended or repealed
mi-oshtemo-charter-township-2026-2.legal_basis: Oshtemo Charter Township Ordinance No. 695, an ordinance imposing a moratorium on Solar Energy Development for Principal-Use SES, Principal-Use (Large) SES, and Principal-Use (Small) SES, adopted at the August 11, 2026 Township Board meeting (second reading; first reading July 28, 2026), published August 20, 2026
mi-oshtemo-charter-township-2026-2.trigger: Need for siting, design, construction and decommissioning standards for large-scale solar while Energy Systems Ordinance is drafted
mi-oshtemo-charter-township-2026-2.current_status: Active as of 2026-09-23; six-month moratorium on new principal-use (large-scale) solar applications adopted 2026-08-11.
mi-oshtemo-charter-township-2026-2.outcome: Planning Commission drafting Energy Systems Ordinance
